# cycle_external_volume (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle external volume by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an external volume by ID.
data "cycle_external_volume" "data" {
  id = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

output "volume_state" {
  value = data.cycle_external_volume.data.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the external volume.

### Read-Only

- `attachment` (String) JSON object describing the volume attachment, if any.
- `cluster` (String) The identifier of the cluster this volume is associated with.
- `description` (String) The custom description of the volume.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this volume belongs to.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the volume.
- `location_id` (String) The provider location ID of the volume.
- `name` (String) The name of the external volume.
- `server_ids` (List of String) Server IDs that this volume can be mounted on.
- `size` (String) Current size of the volume as reported by the API.
- `source` (String) JSON object describing the volume source.
- `state` (String) The current lifecycle state of the volume.
